prompt: You receive £20 as a birthday gift and want to save some of it. When is the best moment to move money into your savings?

options.text: After you have spent on everything else, if anything is left
Never — gifts should all be spent
Only when the savings jar looks empty

explanation: Saving first — moving a set amount aside as soon as money arrives — works because it happens before spending can quietly use the money up.
